## About This Site

This site is a career evaluation product built for MET AD 688, Big Data and
Cloud Analytics for Business, at Boston University Metropolitan College. It
helps a student or early-career professional judge the job market for Data
Analytics roles in Computer Systems Design and Related Services (NAICS 5415).

The product answers one question: how can an aspiring analytics professional
evaluate career opportunities in this industry and decide which skills,
qualifications, and experiences to put first?

| | |
|---|---|
| **Course** | MET AD 688, Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business |
| **Team** | Group 2 |
| **Industry** | Computer Systems Design and Related Services (NAICS 5415) |
| **Career pathway** | Data Analytics |
| **Data** | MET CareerCompass 2026 v2 job-postings extract |
| **Analytical sample** | 1,790 analytics postings, September 2025 to September 2026 |

## Data and Methods

The source is the MET CareerCompass 2026 v2 job-postings extract provided for
the course. The analytical panel keeps analytics-related postings in NAICS 5415
from the most recent twelve months. The filtering steps and their counts are
documented on the [Data Preparation](data_cleaning.qmd) page.

The site is built with Quarto and Python. The cleaned panel, the scripts that
build it, and the model outputs are all stored in the repository, so every
figure on the site can be reproduced.

The results describe advertised job postings in one industry over one year.
They are not a complete picture of the U.S. analytics job market, and each page
lists its own limitations.
